subject: 1_t0.5
notes: BLQ point is always converted to 0, never excluded, regardless of middle/terminal method.

subject: 1_t4
notes: middle_method=interpolate: middle gap at t=4 is imputed, not excluded.

subject: 1_t24
notes: terminal_method=complete: interpolation never applies to terminal points (no next neighbor), so terminal_method still governs and excludes t=24.
